WITH Cnt_DimCustomerAccount AS(
SELECT
AccountID,
COUNT(ShareIndicator) AS CNT
FROM DW.dimcustomeraccount WHERE ShareIndicator = 'y'
GROUP BY AccountID
)
,Balance AS (
        SELECT
        CONVERT(VARCHAR,BRPP.DemandEffectiveDate,112) AS BusinessDateSK
        ,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
        ,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
        ,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
        ,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
        ,0 AS WorkFlowId
        ,0 AS TaskRunId
        ,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
        ,BRPP.IsoCurrencyCode
        ,BRPP.FinancialInstitutionId
        ,BRPP.DemandFlowId
        ,BRPP.DemandAmount
        ,CASE WHEN DemandFlowId = 'PRDEM' THEN BRPP.DemandAmount  ELSE 0 END AS AmortizationAmount
        ,CASE WHEN BRPP.DemandFlowId = 'INDEM' THEN BRPP.DemandAmount  ELSE 0 END AS InterestAmount
        ,CASE WHEN BRPP.DemandFlowId = 'APDEM' THEN BRPP.DemandAmount  ELSE 0 END AS PenaltyAmount
        ,ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1) CNT
        ,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
        FROM 
        [BNKM].[RepaymentPlanPayment] BRPP
        LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BRPP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
        LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
        LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON BRPP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
        LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON BRPP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
        LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DCA.AccountId = BRPP.CustomerAccountId
)
SELECT * INTO dw.factlnsoutstdbal_Balance FROM Balance;

with GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT 
    BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,convert(DATE, MIN(BusinessDateSK)) AS min_date
    ,CONVERT(DATE, MAX(BusinessDateSK)) AS max_date 
    ,DemandFlowId
  FROM 
     dw.factlnsoutstdbal_Balance
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL) AND BusinessDateSK between '20230626' and '20230703' 
	GROUP BY BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountID ,SourceSystemCode,DemandFlowId
)
,FullDateBalance AS (
SELECT 
	BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
	,SourceSystemCode
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,fulldate,112) AS fulldate2
    ,a.FullDate
    ,b.min_date 
    ,b.max_date
    ,DemandFlowId
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    LEFT JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
,distinct_balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK, BankSK, AccountSK, AccountId, BusinessDateSK, SourceSystemCode, WorkFlowId, TaskRunId, InsertDttm ,CNT  ,DemandFlowId ,DemandAmount, IsoCurrencyCode, FinancialInstitutionId, AmortizationAmount, InterestAmount, PenaltyAmount
FROM  dw.factlnsoutstdbal_Balance b
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
,join_balance as (
select 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate)),112)  AS BusinessDateSK
,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId
,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm                           
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,DemandAmount
,ISNULL(b.DemandFlowId,a.DemandFlowId) AS DemandFlowId    
,AmortizationAmount
,InterestAmount
,PenaltyAmount
,CNT
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.BankSK,a.AccountId,A.DemandFlowId ORDER BY a.FullDate ) AS Row#
, case when [DemandAmount] is null OR [DemandAmount] = 0 then 0 else 1 end as ChangeIndicator
FROM FullDateBalance a
LEFT JOIN DISTINCT_BALANCE b
    ON a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
    AND a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
    AND a.fulldate2 = b.BusinessDateSK
    AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode
    AND a.DemandFlowId = b.DemandFlowId
)
SELECT * INTO dw.factlnsoutstdbal_join_balance FROM join_balance;

SELECT
    *
    ,SUM(ChangeIndicator) OVER (PARTITION BY BankSK,AccountId,DemandFlowId ORDER BY Row#) RowGroup
INTO DW.factlnsoutstdbal_rowgrp
FROM dw.factlnsoutstdbal_join_balance;

with final_balance as (
select 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,case when IsoCurrencyCode is not null then IsoCurrencyCode else first_value(IsoCurrencyCode) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK,DemandFlowId ORDER BY Row#) end IsoCurrencyCode
,case when FinancialInstitutionId is not null then FinancialInstitutionId else first_value(FinancialInstitutionId) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK,DemandFlowId ORDER BY Row#) end FinancialInstitutionId
,case when [DemandAmount] is not null then DemandAmount else first_value(DemandAmount) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK,DemandFlowId ORDER BY Row#) end DemandAmount
,case when [CNT] is not null then CNT else first_value(CNT) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK,DemandFlowId ORDER BY Row#) end CNT
,case when [AmortizationAmount] is not null then AmortizationAmount else first_value(AmortizationAmount) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK,DemandFlowId ORDER BY Row#) end AmortizationAmount
,case when [PenaltyAmount] is not null then PenaltyAmount else first_value(PenaltyAmount) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK,DemandFlowId ORDER BY Row#) end PenaltyAmount
,case when [InterestAmount] is not null then InterestAmount else first_value(InterestAmount) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK,DemandFlowId ORDER BY Row#) end InterestAmount
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm                           
from dw.factlnsoutstdbal_rowgrp
) 
SELECT * INTO dw.factlnsoutstdbal_final_balance FROM final_balance;

WITH CurrencyConversion AS (
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)
,Cnt_DimCustomerAccount AS (
select Accountid,
count(shareindicator) as CNT
 from dw.dimcustomeraccount where shareindicator = 'y'
 group by accountid
)
,Main AS (
SELECT 
CONVERT(VARCHAR,CONVERT(DATE,BRPP.BusinessDateSK),112) AS BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,BRPP.AccountId
,SUM(AmortizationAmount) AS AmortizationAmount
,SUM(InterestAmount) AS InterestAmount
,SUM(PenaltyAmount) AS PenaltyAmount
,SUM(AmortizationAmount) + SUM(InterestAmount) + SUM(PenaltyAmount) AS OutstandingBalanceFull
,(SUM(AmortizationAmount) + SUM(InterestAmount) + SUM(PenaltyAmount) ) / ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1)  AS OutstandingBalanceProrated
,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM (
select
 BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,CASE WHEN BRPP.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BRPP.AmortizationAmount * CC.ConversionRate ELSE BRPP.AmortizationAmount END AS AmortizationAmount
,CASE WHEN BRPP.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BRPP.InterestAmount * CC.ConversionRate ELSE BRPP.InterestAmount END AS InterestAmount
,CASE WHEN BRPP.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BRPP.PenaltyAmount * CC.ConversionRate ELSE BRPP.PenaltyAmount END AS PenaltyAmount
FROM dw.factlnsoutstdbal_final_balance   BRPP
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON  BRPP.IsoCurrencyCode  = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BRPP.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,BRPP.BusinessDateSK) = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
) BRPP
LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DCA.AccountId = BRPP.AccountId
GROUP BY 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,BRPP.AccountId
,DCA.CNT
)
SELECT COUNT(1) AS Main
FROM Main;

drop table dw.factlnsoutstdbal_Balance
drop table dw.factlnsoutstdbal_join_balance
drop table dw.factlnsoutstdbal_rowgrp
drop table dw.factlnsoutstdbal_final_balance

SELECT COUNT(1) AS factlnsoutstdbal_Balance
FROM DW.factlnsoutstdbal_Balance

SELECT COUNT(1) AS factlnsoutstdbal_join_balance
FROM DW.factlnsoutstdbal_join_balance

SELECT COUNT(1) AS factlnsoutstdbal_rowgrp
FROM DW.factlnsoutstdbal_rowgrp

SELECT COUNT(1) AS factlnsoutstdbal_final_balance
FROM DW.factlnsoutstdbal_final_balance
